rationale:
Issue #8 states verbatim that CalculationMethod.egyptian uses fajrAngle 20.0 and ishaAngle 18.0 where 19.5 and 17.5 are correct. The minimized production patch is a single hunk in lib/src/calculation_method.dart changing exactly those two literals (20.0->19.5, 18.0->17.5); the surrounding CalculationParameters construction and withMethodAdjustments(dhuhr: 1) block are untouched, so there is no refactor, formatting, feature, docs, or config change. The fix commit message closes #8 and cites the upstream adhan-java fix, and traceability records fix_commit_to_issue with verified_fix_issue_numbers=[8], matching the single allowed root cause id. The trigger is the unchanged upstream test portion of the same commit: test/src/calculation_method_test.dart 'Test CalculationMethod.getParameters' updates two expectations to 19.5/17.5 using only pre-existing APIs (CalculationMethod.egyptian.getParameters(), params.fajrAngle/ishaAngle, almostEqualD helper), so it introduces no dependency on an API created by the fix and asserts precisely the reported defect. Strict evidence (both pre- and post-minimization) reports all gates passed: build on both revisions, isolated buggy differential failure on the single declared selector, deterministic fingerprints across 3 repetitions over a 32-run matrix, fixed-revision isolated/suite/reversed runs clean, and buggy full-suite failures limited to the reproduced trigger. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no registry entry.

Issue #8 (created 2021-02-15, before the fix commit) states that CalculationMethod.egyptian returns fajrAngle 20.0 and ishaAngle 18.0 when they should be 19.5 and 17.5, describing a pre-existing wrong-constant defect. The minimized production patch is a single hunk in lib/src/calculation_method.dart changing exactly those two literals (fajrAngle: 20.0 -> 19.5, ishaAngle: 18.0 -> 17.5) inside the CalculationMethod.egyptian branch; the surrounding withMethodAdjustments call, structure, and formatting are untouched, so there is no refactor, feature extension, doc-only, or config-only content. The trigger patch is the upstream test portion of the same commit: it updates two existing expectations in test/src/calculation_method_test.dart to 19.5/17.5 using only pre-existing APIs (CalculationMethod.egyptian.getParameters(), params.fajrAngle, params.ishaAngle, helper almostEqualD), so it introduces no production API added by the fix and asserts precisely the values named in the issue. Strict machine evidence (identical for original and post-minimization) reports all gates passed: build on both revisions, trigger.buggy_differential reproducing test/src/calculation_method_test.dart::Test CalculationMethod.getParameters, trigger.deterministic with 3 fingerprint groups over 3 repetitions, trigger.fixed_clean, and full_suite.fixed_all_green with buggy full-suite failures limited to the reproduced trigger, which also rules out collateral breakage from the constant change. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no active registry entry, and iamriajul/adhan-dart#8 is the sole allowed and verified issue key (traceability path fix_commit_to_issue, PR #15).
